```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
starwars <- dplyr::starwars
```

```{r}
starwars_humans <- starwars |>
  filter(
    species == "Human"
  )
```

What is the relationship between height and mass for humans in Star Wars Universe?
```{r}
ggplot(starwars_humans, aes(x = height, y = mass)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = gender), size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Star Wars Humans: Height vs Mass",
    x = "Height (cm)",
    y = "Mass (kg)"
  )
# output: asis
```

What is the average height and mass by gender?
```{r}
starwars_humans |>
  group_by(gender) |>
  summarize(
    avg_height = mean(height, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_mass = mean(mass, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_height))
```
